headline: Turnovers Persist as Fighting Shifts Across Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has climbed from 48 to 52 recorded base events, while Nevish Line has eased from 70 to 68. Both fronts have gone quiet in the latest two hours, though fighting remains costly in each. Marban Hollow’s daily count has fallen from 17 to 12, with no fresh turnover in two hours; Linn Mercy holds at 13 for the day and is likewise quiet in that span. Farranac Coast’s latest record shows all 11 bases Colonial-held after the activity around Transient Valley. Newer movement is reported at Godcrofts, where Argosa logged three events in two hours, and at Mooring County, where The Wind Hills saw two as casualty rates accelerated. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf have also recorded recent daily turnovers, but neither shows an event in the latest two hours. Kuura Strand’s 15 events are older still. War 140 remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
